name: Write gate for every other outward tool
owner_decision: Bambang 2026-09-25: docs/working-agreement.md rule 4 (no write or execution without permission) was enforced only for Confluence / Jira / Slack (G-01), n8n (G-01 B1 + G-02) and git / GitHub (G-04). Every other tool that writes outside the repo is now held until the owner's latest message is a write order.
single_source: This file is the ONLY place the G-05 rules are written. scripts/hooks/g05.py reads it.
binds: Every mcp__ tool that no other gate covers (not mcp__Atlassian_MCP__, mcp__Atlassian_Rovo__, mcp__Slack__, mcp__n8n__, mcp__github__), and the built-in Artifact tool. Enforced by the PreToolUse hook scripts/hooks/pre_tool.py.
rule: A call is allowed when its operation reads (read_verbs below, matched at the start of the operation name after mcp__<server>__) or is on read_tools. Anything else needs the owner's latest message classified WRITE (lexicon.json order_words), and not STOP.

artifact.note: publish (the default when action is omitted), delete, pin and unpin need a WRITE order.

known_limits: The operation name decides read or write; a tool whose name starts with a read verb but writes is not caught.
Built-in tools other than Artifact that act outside the repo must be added to the hook matcher in .claude/settings.json to be seen at all.
Hooks run as the same OS user as the model: they stop shortcuts and forgetting, not a deliberate attack.
